budget.alert.warning: {engine} has used {percent}% of its monthly acquisition allowance. The month is running hot; review cadence, group priorities, and open violations.

An administrator invites you to Patrol, the enforcement tool of {rightsHolder}.

Open the link below, choose a password of at least twelve characters, and enrol your second factor:

Open the link below, choose a new password of at least twelve characters, and enrol your second factor again:

{link}

The link is single-use and expires in twenty-four hours.

pack.handoff.title: Handoff checklist
pack.handoff.signIn.required: The form requires a signed-in account before it accepts a submission.
pack.handoff.signIn.none: The form needs no account; open it directly.
pack.handoff.step.open: Open the recipient's form in a new browser tab; Patrol never drives that tab.
pack.handoff.step.fields: Copy every field from fields.json, in the form's order; required fields are marked.
pack.handoff.step.upload: Upload {file} where the form asks for a URL file.
pack.handoff.step.tick: Tick every statement exactly as printed below; never paraphrase.
pack.handoff.step.sign: Type the signatory's full legal name in every signature field — never an operator's name.
pack.handoff.step.date: Enter today's date where the form asks for one.
pack.handoff.step.submit: Submit the form and record what the recipient returned.
pack.handoff.ack.google: Google: the reference number (4-40 characters) and the Removals Dashboard URL.
pack.handoff.ack.bing: Bing: the TicketId and the ticket-details URL.
pack.handoff.ack.yandex: Yandex: the reply email's Message-ID and the reply date.
pack.handoff.flag.dead: {url}: the newest capture came back dead; the earlier live capture{earlier} is cited beside it. Submit anyway, or supersede the notice without this URL — it is never dropped silently.
pack.handoff.flag.blocked: {url}: the newest capture was blocked — the page exists but refused Patrol. You may still file; the submission records the blocked capture.
pack.handoff.publicity: Filing republishes the contact details through Lumen; they become public.
